key_terms.الْأَفْئِدَةِ: The hearts (plural of فؤاد), referring to the inner core of emotion and thought
key_terms.تَطَّلِعُ: To look into, penetrate, or gain knowledge of something hidden

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah is described as penetrating the hearts?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores Allah's absolute omniscience (ʿIlm al-Ḥaḍrī) over the hidden recesses of the heart, distinguishing divine knowledge from human perception. It serves as a reminder that while humans may conceal intentions, Allah's awareness is immediate and comprehensive, a concept central to the doctrine of divine justice and the Day of Judgment.
